pack.title: Ghosting fading
pack.description: Ask for a plan and stop indefinite chasing.

scenarios.setting: Someone has canceled two dates and still has not suggested another time.
scenarios.jab: We'll figure something out soon, promise.
scenarios.goal: Ask for a plan and stop indefinite chasing.

replies.line: Let me know when you have a day in mind.
replies.why: It puts the next concrete step with the person who canceled.
replies.delivery: Ask once, evenly; let the pause remain instead of sending several follow-up messages.

replies.line: Send a day when you're available.
replies.why: It asks for an actionable proposal rather than more reassurance.
replies.delivery: Ask once, evenly; let the pause remain instead of sending several follow-up messages.

replies.line: I'd like to see you; send a day that works and we'll see if it fits.
replies.why: It shows interest without committing yourself to an unspecified plan.
replies.delivery: Ask once, evenly; let the pause remain instead of sending several follow-up messages.

replies.line: Our calendar could use a date, not a cliffhanger.
replies.why: A gentle joke names the uncertainty without insulting their interest.
replies.delivery: Ask once, evenly; let the pause remain instead of sending several follow-up messages.

followUp.jab: Why are you making this a big deal?
followUp.line: I'm asking for a plan; if now isn't a good time, that's okay.
followUp.why: It clarifies the request and gives a respectful way to decline.
followUp.delivery: Ask once, evenly; let the pause remain instead of sending several follow-up messages.
